record.summary: Amends the State Board of Education rule on school internet safety policies. By 1 Jul 2027 every district school board and charter school governing board must amend its policy to cover AI instructional tools: plain-language notice to parents and opt-in for direct student use, with a non-AI alternative; extra review for VPK to grade 5; no undisclosed behaviour monitoring, social scoring or psychological profiling; human review of AI decisions; adult supervision, logs and a shut-off for agentic AI; training on AI risks; incident reports to the Department; no use of student data to train commercial AI models. AI designed to simulate friendship or meet students' emotional needs is barred.
record.scope_note: A sector-wide rule: the State Board of Education requires every Florida school district and charter school governing board to write AI safety requirements into its own internet safety policy. Included because it binds the whole public school sector, not a single institution.

judgment.status_reasoning: The final notice 31488060 gives rule file date 10/9/2026 and rule effective date 10/29/2026; the rule page shows the latest version as effective 10/29/2026, history 'Amended 10-29-26'. Today is 15 Oct 2026, 14 days before the effective date, so the 2026 AI amendment is adopted but not yet in force (the base rule has been in force since 22 Aug 2023, but this record is about the amendment). date_published stays the rule file date (9 Oct 2026), the date the official rule record gives for the adopted rule; the Board's vote at the 16 Sep 2026 hearing is in notes. The status should become In force after 29 Oct 2026.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific binding amendment that the State Board of Education sets for every school district and charter school in Florida. The precedent of 15 Oct 2026 in pipeline/scope-decisions.md (institutions and sector-wide rules) names 'a state education department's rule for all school districts' as in, with a scope_note, so the record gets one. AGENTS.md section 10 would put AI-specific sub-national implementing regulations in with no note; I followed the newer, more specific precedent.

changes.scope_note: Added under the precedent of 15 Oct 2026 on institutions and sector-wide rules, which names a state education rule for all school districts as in with a scope_note.
changes.summary: Paragraph (3)(e) requires an amendment to each board's internet safety policy that addresses AI instructional tools, not an amendment to a policy on AI tools; the first sentence is shortened to stay within 700 characters; otherwise unchanged.
